title: Probing Alterations in MDM2 Catalytic Core Structure Effect of Garcinia Mangostana Derivatives: Insight from Molecular Dynamics Simulations.
authors: El Habbash, Aisha I; Aljoundi, Aimen; Elamin, Ghazi; Soliman, Mahmoud E S
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟研究MDM2-p53蛋白-蛋白相互作用及天然产物抑制机制，对象为蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合建模无关。
abstract: The MDM2-p53 protein-protein interaction is a promising model for researchers to design, study, and discover new anticancer drugs. The design of therapeutically active compounds that can maintain or restore the binding of MDM2 to p53 has been found to limit the oncogenic activities of both. This led to the current development of a group of xanthone-core and cis-imidazoline analogs compounds, among which gamma-Mangostin (GM), alpha-Mangostin (AM), and Nutlin exhibited their MDM2-p53 interaction inhibitory effects. Therefore, in this study, we seek to determine the mechanisms by which these compounds elicit MDM2-p53 interaction targeting. Unique to the binding of GM, AM, and Nutlin, from our findings, they share the same three active site residues Val76, Tyr50, and Gly41, which represent the top active side residues that contribute to high electrostatic energy. Consequently, the free binding energy contributed enormously to the binding of these compounds, which culminated in the high binding affinities of GM, AM, and Nutlin with high values. Furthermore, GM, AM, and Nutlin commonly interrupted the stable and compact conformation of MDM2 coupled with its active site, where Calpha deviations were relatively high. We believe that our findings would assist in the design of more potent active anticancer drugs.
abstract_zh: MDM2-p53蛋白-蛋白相互作用是研究人员设计、研究并发现新型抗癌药物的一个有前景的模型。已发现，设计能够维持或恢复MDM2与p53结合的治疗活性化合物，可限制两者的致癌活性。这促使了当前一组氧杂蒽酮核心和顺式咪唑啉类似物化合物的开发，其中γ-倒捻子素（GM）、α-倒捻子素（AM）和Nutlin表现出对MDM2-p53相互作用的抑制效果。因此，在本研究中，我们旨在确定这些化合物引发MDM2-p53相互作用靶向的机制。根据我们的发现，GM、AM和Nutlin的结合具有独特性，它们共享三个相同的活性位点残基Val76、Tyr50和Gly41，这些残基代表了贡献高静电能的顶级活性侧残基。因此，自由结合能对这些化合物的结合贡献巨大，最终导致GM、AM和Nutlin具有高结合亲和力且数值较高。此外，GM、AM和Nutlin共同干扰了MDM2及其活性位点的稳定紧凑构象，其中Cα偏差相对较高。我们相信，我们的发现将有助于设计更有效的活性抗癌药物。
